answer: Ghost wallets fail a one-hatch tide they cannot share. An applicant stakes 2.70 POA, claims one 6-minute hatch in a 22-cell shoreline vault, and releases a 31-cm comet drogue into a marked lagoon channel. The drogue's salt-clock and 9-bit flash bind to the pubkey and epoch seed; recovery must land in minutes 11-17. A farm of 200 clones needs 540 POA and 200 exclusive hatches in that tide. Graders replay the hatch draw from the seed, match flash bits to the vault log, and weigh the drogue to 0.3 g. A reused hatch, flash collision, or late recovery slashes 49% and benches the row for two epochs.
